event_summary: Two small spherical objects move across a tabletop in opposite directions and leave the visible area.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a light wood-colored tabletop visible between two black cylindrical objects near the left and right edges. After a period with no moving objects, a brown spherical object appears from the right side near the upper half of the tabletop and moves leftward. Shortly after, a light gray spherical object appears from the left side near the lower half of the tabletop and moves rightward. The two spheres pass through different parts of the tabletop without visibly touching. The brown sphere reaches the upper-left edge area and disappears from view; the gray sphere continues toward the right edge and disappears from view. The tabletop is then visible again with no moving spheres.

reasons: The tabletop and side black cylindrical objects are visible.
The moving spherical objects are not yet visible in the first frame.
